title: Count Numbers With Unique Digits II
description: Given two **positive** integers `a` and `b`, return *the count of numbers having **unique** digits in the range* `[a, b]` *(**inclusive**).*

examples.explanation: All the numbers in the range [1, 20] have unique digits except 11. Hence, the answer is 19.
All the numbers in the range [9, 19] have unique digits except 11. Hence, the answer is 10.
There are 41 numbers in the range [80, 120], 27 of which have unique digits.
